entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' for product help or 'Sales' to place a new order.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to make a return. I have my order number if you need it. I'm just a bit lost with the whole process.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller. Order number is VF789012. It's for the cycling shoes.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the VeloFit Pro-Lite cycling shoes, delivered about a month ago. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?

Oh, I just don't think they're for me. I've tried them a few times and they're giving me terrible blisters. And I can't seem to get the cleats positioned right, no matter what I do. The website was so confusing, I'm not even sure if I can return them now.
I understand. Getting the fit and cleat position right can be tricky. It sounds like a fit preference issue rather than a defect, is that correct?
I... I guess? I just know they hurt my feet. The whole thing is just overwhelming. I just want a refund. Can't you just help me?

Of course, Sarah. I'm here to help. Let me just check the policy for you. I see your order was delivered 32 days ago. Since the cycling shoes are a standard item, they fall under our 90-day return window.
Oh, really? 90 days? I couldn't find that anywhere.

Yes, you are well within the timeframe. I've just initiated the return for you. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions in the next few minutes. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, we'll process your full refund. Does that work for you?
Oh, that's wonderful! Thank you so much, David. That's a huge relief.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
